result.rationale: The migration directly executes "SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'" and immediately calls [0]['id'].to_i. If no such site_settings row exists (settings are only persisted when changed from default — and embed_category's default is ''), the result set is empty and [0] raises NoMethodError on nil, aborting db:migrate. The 'if category_id == 0' fallback is unreachable in that case. The diff shows no guard for a missing row, so the mechanism is verifiable.

judged_text: Migration crashes on default installs (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:9-11): the raw SQL assumes the 'embed_category' site setting row exists, but Discourse only persists settings changed from their default, so on most installs the result set is empty and [0] is nil, aborting db:migrate; the INNER JOIN on category name also crashes when the category was renamed, deleted, or the value was stored as an id, and the 'if category_id == 0' fallback is dead code because the code crashes before reaching it (CI misses this since the test DB is built from schema.rb, not by replaying migrations)

adjudication.rationale: The new migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` does `execute(...)[0]['id']` when selecting the `embed_category` setting via an `INNER JOIN` on `site_settings` (lines shown right after table creation). If no `site_settings` row exists for `embed_category` (common when settings are only persisted when changed), `execute(...)` returns an empty result and `[0]` is `nil`, causing a crash before the later `if category_id == 0` fallback can run. The join on `s.value = c.name` is also brittle because it assumes the stored value matches the current category name.
